nodes.title: fix(enclosure): preserve outputs published by concurrent writers
nodes.body:
## Problem

The enclosure CLI checks that requested outputs are new before interpretation or proposal review, then publishes them with `os.replace`. A second writer can create a completed artifact between those steps; the CLI silently replaces that artifact and reports success.

Six deterministic regressions reproduce the data loss on unchanged main `23c7284048512ca8d956c9a2c4c62eb1f8b8ea89`: local and provider-stub proposals, applying a reviewed proposal, editing a project, and interpretation analysis/project outputs.

## Change

- Add an optional `overwrite=False` mode to the shared text and project writers. It stages complete UTF-8/LF bytes on the destination filesystem, flushes and syncs them, then claims the destination with an atomic hard link.
- Use that mode for the enclosure commands' existing new-output contract. If another writer wins, preserve its file, return the existing CLI error status, and remove the temporary artifact.
- Preserve the existing `overwrite=True` default for other callers. Serialization formats and existing command arguments are unchanged.
- Cover destination collisions at both the command boundary and the final publication primitive, default replacement compatibility, and cleanup when hard-link publication is unavailable. The provider case is a local stub with no transport or model call.

## Validation

- Before the fix: **6/6 enclosure collision regressions fail** because the competing file is overwritten.
- Focused suite: **103 passed**.

nodes.title: fix(daemon): bound shutdown and preserve queued work for restart
nodes.body:
## Problem

The daemon puts shutdown sentinels into the same bounded queue used for generation. When that queue is full and a worker is still generating, `stop_workers()` blocks in `queue.put(None)` before reaching its intended join deadline. Even when the sentinel fits, workers continue starting queued jobs ahead of it during shutdown.

## Change

- Signal stopping independently of queue capacity.
- Stop claiming queued jobs; retain their durable records for the existing startup recovery.
- Allow in-flight generation to settle within one shared five-second worker-join budget.
- Refuse new submissions once stopping has begun.
- Add five focused regressions for a full queue, in-flight completion plus restart recovery, idle workers, the shared deadline, and late submissions.

Only `core/daemon.py` and `tests/test_daemon_shutdown.py` change.

## Verification

On the final candidate: **31 tests passed** across the new shutdown suite and the existing terminal-daemon suite; Ruff and mypy passed. Two existing Unix-socket integration tests were attempted and failed at socket construction with `PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted` in the local execution environment.
